dod_check.detail: no acceptance test file the branch added or changed

judge.rationale: The candidate only produced a planning document (`.lore/dod.md`) and a single test file (`src/transport/ws/conversation-list.acceptance.test.ts`), without modifying a single line of production code, documentation, or specifications. Consequently, the tests in the added test file that call `validateMessage({type: 'list_conversations'})` will immediately fail because `validation.ts` was never updated. None of the requested types (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `StoreCannotList`, `UNSUPPORTED`), WebSocket handlers, config options (`transport.history`), specs, or changelog entries were implemented.
